props.name: permission
props.description: The browser permission this card asks for.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Defaults to a plain request for the permission.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why the product needs it — the value to the reader, said before the browser asks.

props.name: allowLabel
props.description: Text of the button that triggers the real browser prompt.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a Not now button. Called when it is pressed.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called on every state change, including changes made in the browser’s own settings.

props.name: deniedInstructions
props.description: Replaces the built-in steps for turning a blocked permission back on.

props.name: previewState
props.description: Render a fixed state without touching the browser — for docs and design review.
